data.body: VALIDATION_DEFERRED: Runtime session validation deferred to post-sprint execution. Rationale: /debug-everything ci-pr mode is implemented as SKILL.md guidance for LLM execution — automated execution from within the active sprint session would create nested .debug-active/.sprint-active state conflicts. Reference bug set is staged (see REFERENCE_BUG_SET comment). Operator must run: (1) /dso:debug-everything against the staged bug set in a fresh session with merge.strategy=pr, recording sub-branch count, pass-rate, token spend; (2) same run with merge.strategy=direct for baseline; (3) record REFERENCE_RUN_RESULTS once both runs complete. Structural tests (tests/scripts/test-debug-everything-phase-f-subbranch.sh, test-debug-everything-phase-g-subbranch.sh, test-debug-everything-subbranch-review.sh, test-debug-everything-branch-tracking.sh, test-debug-everything-leak-detection.sh, test-debug-everything-bugfix-subbranch.sh, test-debug-everything-ci-pr-mode.sh) provide contract coverage for all documented behaviors.
